title: Nobody is logged out by the release and no message shows
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in to production (the live app, app.shopview.com) as an Admin of the production test account, at its test location, Trucks Hill 2.
  • Shortly before the release reached production, have a new staff member for this test on production, staff member A, active, on the built-in Technician role, with Time Clock on, Billable set to Yes, enrolled at Trucks Hill 2, who can sign in (written down with a screenshot of the staff record).
  • Have staff member A signed in on production in a second browser while the release reaches production, with any page open.
custom_steps: 1. In the second browser, click Work Orders in the menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work Orders opens: staff member A is still signed in.
  • No message about the release step shows.
